highlights: REMAX K16 Wireless Lavalier Microphone with Magnetic Clip, Digital Display, and Dual Microphone Connection –
Versatile Wireless Microphone: It is an ideal clip-on wireless microphone system for live streaming, short video creation, outdoor filming, and interviews.
Magnetic Clip Design: Features a convenient magnetic clip for secure attachment to clothing, ensuring stable audio capture during movement.
Digital Display: Equipped with a digital display for easy monitoring of battery life and other essential information
Dual Microphone Support: One transmitter can connect to two microphones simultaneously, perfect for two-person interviews or recordings.
Long Battery Life: Enjoy up to 6 hours of continuous use on a single charge, with a quick recharge time of 1 hour.
